articles.title: Anchoring the Future: India Maritime Week 2025 Set to Elevate Global Trade
articles.description: The Shipping Ministry hosted an Ambassadors' Roundtable Meet to prepare for India Maritime Week 2025. The event, led by Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal, emphasized India's maritime sector's role in driving economic growth and sustainability. The 2025 event aims to position India as a major global maritime hub.

articles.title: Legacy of Speed: Mansour Ojjeh’s McLaren Collection Sold
articles.description: A rare collection of 20 nearly new McLaren road cars owned by the late Mansour Ojjeh has been sold to one anonymous buyer. A special raid team, formed due to rising thefts, conducted a successful operation following intelligence inputs. The criminals altered the vehicles' appearances, selling them with forged documents.
